backgrounds.name: the stars' flow, true scale
backgrounds.description: The stars' own flow of space at its true scale: each star's inflow, sqrt(2GM/d), from where the star is at that moment (not where it was a light-travel time before), combined and pointing along g; g is the acceleration of space. Behind it, the waves' strain h+, scaled up 4.91e+03 times: red where space is stretched across the wave's way, blue where it is squeezed.

backgrounds.name: the wave about each ring, ×4.91e+03
backgrounds.description: The flow of space each ring moves in: the outgoing wave near the ring taken as a plane wave, a shear about the ring's centre - scaled up 4.91e+03 times, as the strain is, so thousands of times its true size. Drawn only near each ring, where the model's flow for the wave is worked out; never added to the stars' flow, which is at its true scale. Behind it, the waves' strain h+, scaled up 4.91e+03 times: red where space is stretched across the wave's way, blue where it is squeezed.

backgrounds.name: the stars' turning flow and its seam, within 4 a
backgrounds.description: The stars' eikonal flow turning with them, at its true scale: each star carries its own flow, down zero-energy paths out of it, and their regions meet at the seam (dashed), which turns with them. It is a Newtonian flow, built in the frame turning with the stars, which moves at c about 5 orbit radii (a) out, so it is drawn only within 4 a. Behind it, the waves' strain h+, scaled up 4.91e+03 times: red where space is stretched across the wave's way, blue where it is squeezed.
